correctness.rationale: Exact diagonalization gives \(b_1-b_2=au+\delta(1-u)>0\); the Nyström block eigenvalues are \(1-\delta_c\) and \(1-\delta\). The sign of \(\delta-\delta_c\) proves all branches and the equal-eigenvalue boundary. Angular and eigenvalue inequalities follow by direct positive rational comparisons. Explicit four-by-four rational reconstruction and 874 exact parameter configurations passed; the analytic proof covers all admissible real \(a,u,\delta\).

This informs near-cluster eigenpair interpretation without asserting broad failure.
